capabilities: Render vertical and horizontal timelines from note frontmatter
Display timelines as Bases views (cross, horizontal, grid)
Configure named timelines with custom month names, colors and image sizes
Pick event images via a frontmatter-to-folder priority chain
Jump to today's date when the Calendarium plugin is installed
extras: Currently installable only via BRAT; support and discussion happen in the Obsidian TTRPG Community Discord; the Bases Timeline (Grid) view is marked in-development; hover popovers require the Page Preview core plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize dated events stored in note properties, especially for fictional calendars with custom month names.

relations.evidence: Bases - utilises the core Bases functionality within Obsidian

summary: Timeline renderer that draws vertical and horizontal timelines from fc-date/fc-end frontmatter properties, as code blocks or Bases views.
